name: MonarchTypeToConfirmInput
title: TypeToConfirmInput
summary: The "type the name to confirm" field for an action that cannot be undone: a MonarchTextField that knows the phrase and announces a match.
whenToUse: Before deleting something that cannot be restored, when a plain confirmation is too easy to tap through.
whenNotToUse: For ordinary destructive actions use confirmationDialog with a destructive button (see confirm-dialog).
api: init(phrase: String, text: Binding<String>, label: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, showsMismatch: Bool = false, mismatchMessage: String? = nil, matchAnnouncement: String? = nil, mismatchAnnouncement: String? = nil, onMatchChange: (@MainActor (Bool) -> Void)? = nil)
static func matches(_ text: String, phrase: String) -> Bool

options.name: phrase
options.description: The exact text the person must type, usually the record's own name.

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label. By default "Type “phrase” to confirm".

options.name: showsMismatch
options.description: Shows the error while the text does not match. Set it after a submit attempt.

options.name: mismatchMessage
options.description: Replaces the built-in "The text does not match."

options.name: matchAnnouncement
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Text matches" announcement. An empty string is silence.

options.name: mismatchAnnouncement
options.description: Announced when the text stops matching. Nothing by default.

options.name: onMatchChange
options.description: Runs each time the match state flips, not for the first state.

states.name: not matching
states.description: A plain text field. No error unless showsMismatch is set.

states.name: mismatch shown
states.description: The text field's error state: danger border, icon and message.

states.name: matching
states.description: A plain text field; the match is announced and reported, not drawn.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The text field's disabled state, set with disabled(_:).

appearance: The appearance of MonarchTextField in every theme.
platformNotes: The web shows the phrase in a monospaced face inside the label; MonarchTextField takes a plain string, so the default label puts the phrase in quotation marks. Matching is the web's rule: case-sensitive, ignoring surrounding white space.
accessibility: The field is read as a text field whose label names the phrase.
"Text matches" is announced when the typed text starts to match.
The mismatch error is an icon and text and is announced by the text field when it appears.
The error never shows while typing unless the app sets showsMismatch.
Autocorrection and capitalisation are off, so the keyboard does not change the typed name.
edgeCases: Spaces and line breaks around the typed text and around the phrase are ignored; spaces inside are not.
An empty phrase matches empty text.
The component does not disable any button; use matches(_:phrase:) or onMatchChange for that.
